name: budget-propose
description: Show the owner proposed changes to budget categories and monthly amounts, as a card in the web chat they asked from. CHANGES NOTHING: the owner must reply "yes" or press Apply on the card. Replaces any proposal still waiting in that chat, so send every category in one call. Amounts are Canadian dollars.

inputs.months: string[]? (the months the amounts are for, each YYYY-MM, in order)
inputs.categories: object[] (each { name, type: expense|income|savings, amounts: [dollars or null, one per month in the same order], renameFrom?: current name when renaming, archive?: true to close a category })

outputs.netWorthIfApproved: object? (net worth today and at each month end if approved as proposed)
